review.assessment: The change introduces a new file, solution.sh, containing only grep -v '^#', which strips lines starting with # at column 1 but completely ignores indentation rules and blank line removal. Consequently, indented comments and whitespace-only lines are incorrectly preserved in the output. The host's acceptance phase produced no measurement due to an empty configured command, preventing automated validation of this execution.

findings.defect: Ignores whitespace before #: Anchoring ^ excludes lines where the comment marker is preceded by indentation, violating the spec that the first non-whitespace character must be #.
Does not filter blank/whitespace-only lines: The script lacks any logic to remove empty or whitespace-padded lines.
